findings.finding: Coverage Metadata - Survey Data exposes OGC API Features alongside WMS/WFS and is OGL.
OGC collection list exposes National_LIDAR_Programme_Index_Catalogue and LIDAR_DTM_Time_Stamped_Extents in storage CRS EPSG:27700.
National live items expose populated dtm_fn, tilename, flown dates, survey IDs and resolution; Time Stamped live items expose dtm_name, ostilename, flown dates, resolution, transform and geoid.
OGC conformance advertises Features filter, CRS, CQL2 basic/text/spatial, ECQL and search capabilities; XML WFS FeatureType parsing is not required for query construction.
OS Terrain50 current download page reports Version Date July 2026 and ASCII Grid/GML among formats.
Downloads API documentation permits area=TQ for OpenData download filtering and automation guidance requires dynamic product/download discovery.
Service status page provides an independent status channel for OS Downloads API; API availability must still be checked at execution time rather than inferred from static documentation.
Current July 2026 INSPIRE/native-BNG/general-boundary safeguards remain unchanged and are not promoted to exact legal boundary evidence.
